up: Return the distinct target names for assays where the organism is Cavia porcellus. Ensure that each returned target name appears only once. No additional filters, columns, or ranking are required beyond the target name and organism.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM assays ass
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE ass.assay_organism = 'Cavia porcellus';
